1	#!/bin/bash
2	# Install/uninstall AWS SSO credential refresh service
3	# Runs aws-sso-util login periodically to keep credentials fresh
4	# If session is valid, refreshes silently. If expired, opens browser.
5	
6	set -e
7	
8	SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
9	
10	# Refresh interval in seconds (4 hours = 14400)
11	# SSO sessions typically last 8-12 hours, so refreshing every 4 hours keeps us ahead
12	REFRESH_INTERVAL=14400
13	
14	# Detect OS
15	detect_os() {
16	    case "$(uname -s)" in
17	        Darwin*) echo "macos" ;;
18	        Linux*)  echo "linux" ;;
19	        *)       echo "unknown" ;;
20	    esac
21	}
22	
23	# Find aws-sso-util
24	find_aws_sso_util() {
25	    if command -v aws-sso-util &>/dev/null; then
26	        command -v aws-sso-util
27	    elif [ -f "$HOME/.local/bin/aws-sso-util" ]; then
28	        echo "$HOME/.local/bin/aws-sso-util"
29	    else
30	        echo ""
31	    fi
32	}
33	
34	OS=$(detect_os)
35	
36	# macOS launchd functions
37	macos_install() {
38	    local plist_name="com.aws.sso-refresh.plist"
39	    local plist_dest="${HOME}/Library/LaunchAgents/${plist_name}"
40	    local logs_dir="${HOME}/Library/Logs"
41	
42	    echo "Installing AWS SSO refresh launchd service..."
43	
44	    local sso_util_path=$(find_aws_sso_util)
45	    if [ -z "$sso_util_path" ]; then
46	        echo "Error: aws-sso-util not found. Install with: pip install aws-sso-util"
47	        exit 1
48	    fi
49	
50	    mkdir -p "$logs_dir"
51	
52	    # Generate plist - runs every REFRESH_INTERVAL seconds
53	    cat > "$plist_dest" <<EOF
54	<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
55	<!DOCTYPE plist PUBLIC "-//Apple//DTD PLIST 1.0//EN" "http://www.apple.com/DTDs/PropertyList-1.0.dtd">
56	<plist version="1.0">
57	<dict>
58	    <key>Label</key>
59	    <string>com.aws.sso-refresh</string>
60	
61	    <key>ProgramArguments</key>
62	    <array>
63	        <string>${sso_util_path}</string>
64	        <string>login</string>
65	        <string>--all</string>
66	    </array>
67	
68	    <key>RunAtLoad</key>
69	    <true/>
70	
71	    <key>StartInterval</key>
72	    <integer>${REFRESH_INTERVAL}</integer>
73	
74	    <key>EnvironmentVariables</key>
75	    <dict>
76	        <key>PATH</key>
77	        <string>/usr/local/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:${HOME}/.local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin</string>
78	        <key>HOME</key>
79	        <string>${HOME}</string>
80	    </dict>
81	
82	    <key>StandardOutPath</key>
83	    <string>${logs_dir}/aws-sso-refresh.log</string>
84	
85	    <key>StandardErrorPath</key>
86	    <string>${logs_dir}/aws-sso-refresh.error.log</string>
87	</dict>
88	</plist>
89	EOF
90	
91	    launchctl load "$plist_dest"
92	
93	    echo "SSO refresh service installed."
94	    echo "Logs: $logs_dir/aws-sso-refresh.log"
95	    echo ""
96	    echo "The service will:"
97	    echo "  - Run immediately on load"
98	    echo "  - Refresh every $(( REFRESH_INTERVAL / 3600 )) hours"
99	    echo "  - Open browser only if SSO session has fully expired"
100	}
101	
102	macos_uninstall() {
103	    local plist_dest="${HOME}/Library/LaunchAgents/com.aws.sso-refresh.plist"
104	
105	    echo "Uninstalling AWS SSO refresh service..."
106	    launchctl unload "$plist_dest" 2>/dev/null || true
107	    rm -f "$plist_dest"
108	    echo "Service uninstalled."
109	}
110	
111	macos_status() {
112	    if launchctl list 2>/dev/null | grep -q "com.aws.sso-refresh"; then
113	        echo "Service is loaded"
114	        launchctl list com.aws.sso-refresh 2>/dev/null || true
115	    else
116	        echo "Service is not loaded"
117	    fi
118	}
119	
120	# Linux systemd functions
121	linux_install() {
122	    local service_dest="${HOME}/.config/systemd/user/aws-sso-refresh.service"
123	    local timer_dest="${HOME}/.config/systemd/user/aws-sso-refresh.timer"
124	
125	    echo "Installing AWS SSO refresh systemd service..."
126	
127	    local sso_util_path=$(find_aws_sso_util)
128	    if [ -z "$sso_util_path" ]; then
129	        echo "Error: aws-sso-util not found. Install with: pip install aws-sso-util"
130	        exit 1
131	    fi
132	
133	    mkdir -p "${HOME}/.config/systemd/user"
134	
135	    # Service file (one-shot, triggered by timer)
136	    cat > "$service_dest" <<EOF
137	[Unit]
138	Description=AWS SSO Credential Refresh
139	
140	[Service]
141	Type=oneshot
142	ExecStart=${sso_util_path} login --all
143	Environment="PATH=/usr/local/bin:${HOME}/.local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin"
144	EOF
145	
146	    # Timer file
147	    cat > "$timer_dest" <<EOF
148	[Unit]
149	Description=AWS SSO Credential Refresh Timer
150	
151	[Timer]
152	OnBootSec=1min
153	OnUnitActiveSec=${REFRESH_INTERVAL}s
154	Persistent=true
155	
156	[Install]
157	WantedBy=timers.target
158	EOF
159	
160	    systemctl --user daemon-reload
161	    systemctl --user enable aws-sso-refresh.timer
162	    systemctl --user start aws-sso-refresh.timer
163	    # Run once immediately
164	    systemctl --user start aws-sso-refresh.service || true
165	
166	    echo "SSO refresh service installed."
167	    echo "View logs: journalctl --user -u aws-sso-refresh.service"
168	    echo ""
169	    echo "The service will:"
170	    echo "  - Run 1 minute after boot"
171	    echo "  - Refresh every $(( REFRESH_INTERVAL / 3600 )) hours"
172	    echo "  - Open browser only if SSO session has fully expired"
173	}
174	
175	linux_uninstall() {
176	    echo "Uninstalling AWS SSO refresh service..."
177	
178	    systemctl --user stop aws-sso-refresh.timer 2>/dev/null || true
179	    systemctl --user disable aws-sso-refresh.timer 2>/dev/null || true
180	    rm -f "${HOME}/.config/systemd/user/aws-sso-refresh.service"
181	    rm -f "${HOME}/.config/systemd/user/aws-sso-refresh.timer"
182	    systemctl --user daemon-reload
183	
184	    echo "Service uninstalled."
185	}
186	
187	linux_status() {
188	    echo "Timer status:"
189	    systemctl --user status aws-sso-refresh.timer 2>/dev/null || echo "Timer not found"
190	    echo ""
191	    echo "Last run:"
192	    systemctl --user status aws-sso-refresh.service 2>/dev/null || echo "Service not found"
193	}
194	
195	# Main
196	case "$1" in
197	    install)
198	        case "$OS" in
199	            macos) macos_install ;;
200	            linux) linux_install ;;
201	            *) echo "Unsupported OS: $OS"; exit 1 ;;
202	        esac
203	        ;;
204	    uninstall)
205	        case "$OS" in
206	            macos) macos_uninstall ;;
207	            linux) linux_uninstall ;;
208	            *) echo "Unsupported OS: $OS"; exit 1 ;;
209	        esac
210	        ;;
211	    status)
212	        case "$OS" in
213	            macos) macos_status ;;
214	            linux) linux_status ;;
215	            *) echo "Unsupported OS: $OS"; exit 1 ;;
216	        esac
217	        ;;
218	    *)
219	        echo "AWS SSO Credential Refresh Service"
220	        echo "Detected OS: $OS"
221	        echo ""
222	        echo "Usage: $0 {install|uninstall|status}"
223	        echo ""
224	        echo "  install   - Install periodic SSO refresh (every 4 hours)"
225	        echo "  uninstall - Remove SSO refresh service"
226	        echo "  status    - Check service status"
227	        echo ""
228	        echo "Note: If SSO session is valid, refresh is silent."
229	        echo "      If expired, a browser window will open for re-auth."
230	        exit 1
231	        ;;
232	esac
233
